sealed_statement_assessment.coordinate_invariance: On finite-dimensional real inner-product E, an orthonormal coordinate identification equates the canonical Hessian contraction with the sum of coordinate second derivatives, and the Riesz-gradient inner product with the coordinate derivative dot product. This is an internal adapter, not a public binder.
sealed_statement_assessment.dimension_zero: Finite real Hilbert E may have dimension zero. Every first derivative and gradient is zero and the Laplacian is an empty trace, so both sides vanish. This valid case is beyond the book standing n>1.
sealed_statement_assessment.dimension_one: The scalar one-dimensional second-derivative product rule supplies the low-dimensional extension. The book standing n>1 must remain literal provenance.
sealed_statement_assessment.source_credit: Eq1.19 is asserted for real C2 functions on the source Euclidean domain; its product derivation is omitted. Locality, basis transport and dim0/1 are explicit SOURCE_GENERALIZATION obligations, not author-written all-dimensional statements.
sealed_statement_assessment.binder_audit: The updated seal explicitly labels the weaker local premise/stronger theorem relationship; no excess public premise was found.

accepted_boundaries: The source global C2 premise is domainwise C2 on an open source domain, not global smoothness through the Poisson pole.
Prop1.18 remains open: real factor C2 off the pole, radial derivative formulas and cancellation using norm(zeta)=1 remain source gaps.
Prop1.20(b) route through Eq1.14 OR route through symmetry+Prop1.18+mean value are alternatives, not an AND.
For nonzero interior x, transformed pole x/|x|^2 has norm 1/|x|>1, supplying a neighborhood of the closed unit ball; x=0 separately uses P(0,zeta)=1 and sigma(S)=1.
Theorem1.17 is continuous on the closed ball and harmonic on the open ball; differentiation under the integral and the entire near/far boundary estimate remain explicit.
Theorem1.21 assumes closed-ball continuity and interior harmonicity. Its representation is stronger than the motivational neighborhood-harmonic Eq1.14 interface.
Both A1 identities are used together at B7.Ex61: they are AND inputs, unlike the two OR normalization routes.
Raw A1 contains both n>=2 and a later where n>=3. Both remain visible; B7 n>=3 satisfies both without editorial correction.
The paper bibliographic R. Wade and the book Wade Ramey are preserved separately.
Actual normalized volume-derived surface measure, finite positive normalization, and full-Haar first-column law equality remain open; normalized source notation does not certify these.
B7 selected n>=3,kappa>=4 must internally yield 0<r<1,lambda>0=>lambda>=0 and C>0; actual support |U|<=1 supplies kernel bounds and L1.
Eq1.19 alone completes no Poisson harmonicity, sphere normalization, A1 numerical value, evaluated Eq24, TV, oracle/query/cost or main theorem.

root_closure_verdict.downstream_topology: ACCEPTED for the pinned bounded slice: full-scope book and paper source regions have explicit dispositions, consumer directions and AND/OR logic match the raw sources, omitted derivations and imported interfaces remain open.
root_closure_verdict.scope_of_approval: Source topology and statement fidelity only. No implementation, axiom, compilation, publication, mathematical proof completion or purification approval is supplied.
